meta.title: Check a certificate · Chiibitsu Labs
meta.description: Check a Chiibitsu Labs course certificate from its link. Shows whether it is valid, revoked or not found.

placeholder: Placeholder. This is sample data from the certificate format's tests, shown on previews only. It is not a real certificate.

valid.body: Issued by Chiibitsu Labs, not a government body. This record has not changed since it was sealed on {date}.

revoked.body: Chiibitsu Labs issued this certificate and revoked it on {date}. It no longer counts as proof that the course was completed.

notFound.h1: No sealed certificate matches this link.
notFound.body: The link holds a complete certificate record, but Chiibitsu Labs has not sealed it on the Aikiri Network ledger. If the course ended recently, its cohort may not be sealed yet. Until it is sealed, this link is not proof that the course was completed.

invalid.body: This link is not a complete certificate record. Make sure you copied the whole link.

error.body: The Aikiri Network ledger could not be read just now.

honest.heading: What this page shows
items: Only what Chiibitsu Labs issued. A Chiibitsu Labs certificate says a person finished a Chiibitsu Labs course.
It is not a government certification, licence or accredited qualification.
Valid means this exact record is sealed on the Aikiri Network ledger and has not been revoked. It does not say what the person can do today.
The certificate's details travel inside its link and stay on your device. Your browser works out the record's fingerprint and looks only that up in the Aikiri Network ledger.
One certificate at a time: the one whose link you have. There is no list or search of certificates.
